RAMESH SOMASUNDARAM 9943993925| rameshsundaram@rediffmail.com

CAREER SUMMARY

Investment Operations professional with 20+ years of experience across fund accounting, capital markets operations, and asset servicing within global financial institutions. Strong expertise in fund accounting, NAV validation and oversight, reconciliation and multi asset class processing including equities, derivatives, fixed income and OTC.

Proven leadership experience in managing large teams, ensuring SLA adherence, and delivering accurate and timely NAV through robust control frameworks and exception management.

Demonstrated ability in stakeholder management, break resolution, audit compliance and process transformation with continuous improvement within complex investment banking environments.

Ability to demonstrate the issues and deal with real life scenarios • Strong analysis skills to identify the risks and in turn identify the preventive measurements • Believe in process, quality initiatives and transformation initiatives for efficiency gains • Excellent team player and flexible to adapt to new environments

EDUCATION AND CERTIFICATION

MBA (Investment Management) | Alagappa University

Investment Operations Certificate | CISI (Global Securities Operations, Introduction to Securities & Investment and Operations Risk)

CORE COMPETENCIES

Fund Accounting & NAV Oversight (Mutual Funds / Hedge Funds / PE) • Reconciliations (Cash, Position, NAV Break Resolution) • Pricing validation and exception analysis • Fee accruals (Management fees and Income accruals) • Asset Servicing (Trade Processing, Income Processing, Securities Lending & Corporate actions) • Operations Control & Risk Management • SLA / KPI Governance & Reporting • Stakeholder Management (Global Clients / Onshore Teams) • Audit & Compliance (Internal / External Controls) • Root Cause Analysis & Process Improvement • Workforce Planning & Shift Management • Team Leadership, Performance Management & Mentoring • MS Excel (Advanced), PowerPoint, Reporting & MIS

2010

2018

WORK EXPERIENCE – INVESTMENT OPERATIONS

Senior Manager | State street, Coimbatore

Jun 2015- Sep 2025

Operations & Domain Leadership

Managed end-to-end fund accounting and pre-NAV operations, including trade validation, cash processing, pricing, income accruals, and portfolio valuation across multiple asset classes

Performed NAV review and validation checks, ensured accuracy of pricing, accruals and cash positions prior to final NAV release

Ensured accurate and timely NAV release through effective exception management and cross-functional



coordination Led Institutional Investor Services covering mutual fund operations, income processing, securities lending, collateral management, and portfolio valuation

Reconciliation & Break Resolution

Oversaw cash and position reconciliations, investigated breaks, and ensured timely resolution within defined SLAs

Co-ordinated with corporate action teams to validate events including dividends, splits, and income distributions ensuring accurate accounting impact

Performed dividend and interest reconciliation with broker/custodian reports

Controls, Risk & Audit



Implemented robust control framework (4-eye checks, quality reviews) ensuring high accuracy in NAV and reporting

Acted as Audit SPOC (M&T controls) ensuring compliance with internal and external audit requirements • Conducted root cause analysis on operational issues and implemented corrective/preventive actions • Ensured all processes are aligned with regulatory and risk management standards

Leadership & People Management



Led and managed a team of analysts and associates and managers, ensuring delivery against SLAs and quality benchmarks

Conducted performance reviews, coaching, and development planning • Managed workforce planning, shift allocation, and capacity management to support business continuity • Acted as escalation point for operational issues and stakeholder queries

Stakeholder & Client Management

Collaborated with global clients, custodians, and internal stakeholders to resolve complex operational issues • Prepared and presented MIS reports (weekly/monthly) covering SLA performance, risk metrics, and operational updates

Built strong client relationships through effective communication and issue resolution

Change Management & Process Improvement

• • Maintained SOPs, SLAs, and process documentation aligned with governance standards

Supported process transitions, system enhancements, and client onboarding initiatives Led initiatives to improve operational efficiency, reduce errors, and enhance turnaround times

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE – CAPITAL MARKET OPERATIONS

Religare Securities Ltd as Relationship Manager : From September 2012 to July 2013. Indbank Merchant Banking Services Limited Sharekhan Limited Kotak Securities Limited Ramahpurva shares Pvt. Ltd

: From August 2008 to June 2012 : From June 2006 to July 2008 : From January 2004 to June 2006 : From November 2001 to December 2003

Responsible for Equities, Derivatives & commodities trading and MF investments on behalf of clients • Reconciliation & verification of Bank Transaction Statement towards payment & receipt authorization. • Monitored risk exposure and compliance to ensure the company policy is met • Authorized signatory to process Delivery Instruction Slip (DIS) for Pay ins. • Monitoring, Processing and handling of settlements for both NSE and BSE • Monitoring limit Exposure of the clients thereby providing adequate risk management for the organization. • Handling of all the back office operations relating to Normal Pay-In’ s of both the major Stock Exchanges BSE and NSE

To reduce the risks in Equity, applying Futures and Options hedging strategy • Guiding clients on MF investments, Dematerialization, share transfer and off-market transactions • Maintaining standard of quality in client service by monitoring client’s portfolio and advised for proper allocation of stocks
